nodes.description: mint(uint amount) public payable: gated mint function with owner bypass when paused, price check and loop calling mintGoblin
mintGoblin(uint id) private: mints token and assigns random gold coins from on-chain entropy
withdraw() external onlyOwner: distributes contract balance to CobbleAddress, DarkoAddress and msg.sender
setBaseURI(string baseURI) external onlyOwner: updates token base URI
goldBalance(address person) public view: sums gold coins across all tokens owned by person
getGoblinsCoins(uint id) public view: returns goldCoins mapping entry
pause() public onlyOwner: sets paused = true
unpause() public onlyOwner: sets paused = false
bool private paused: mint gate flag
uint private constant mintPrice = 0.03 ether used to validate msg.value
Counters.Counter private _tokenIdTracker: monotonically increasing token id source
mapping(uint=>uint) private goldCoins: per-token gold coin amounts
uint public totalGoldCoins: aggregate of all minted gold coins
address CobbleAddress payout recipient fixed in code
address DarkoAddress payout recipient fixed in code
string private _baseTokenURI: metadata base URI
msg.sender: caller controlled address used for access checks and payouts
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used as randomness entropy
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, totalSupply())) used as randomness source
multiple payable(...).transfer(...) ETH sends in withdraw, last one to msg.sender
uint amount parameter of mint
uint id parameter of mintGoblin
string baseURI parameter of setBaseURI
address person parameter of goldBalance
uint id parameter of getGoblinsCoins
uint randomNumber local in mintGoblin holding hashed entropy
uint randomCoins local in mintGoblin derived from randomNumber modulo
uint balance local in withdraw capturing address(this).balance
uint total local accumulator in goldBalance

edges.reason: mint compares msg.sender to owner() to bypass the paused gate and price check
mint reads paused to decide whether minting is allowed
mint uses mintPrice to validate the required msg.value
mint uses amount for the value requirement and loop iteration count
mint calls mintGoblin once per iteration
mint increments and reads _tokenIdTracker to derive the token id
mintGoblin mints the new token directly to msg.sender
block.timestamp feeds the on-chain randomness hash
weak randomness result is assigned to randomNumber
randomNumber modulo 100 selects randomCoins value
randomCoins is written into the goldCoins mapping
randomCoins is added to totalGoldCoins
mintGoblin updates totalGoldCoins state variable
withdraw onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender and pays msg.sender
withdraw executes the ETH transfer unsafe operation
CobbleAddress is a transfer recipient
DarkoAddress is a transfer recipient
balance local determines the transfer amounts
ETH transfer to msg.sender can trigger a callback into the recipient
external ETH transfer callback can reenter withdraw before finalization
setBaseURI writes _baseTokenURI
setBaseURI onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender
baseURI parameter is written to _baseTokenURI
getGoblinsCoins reads the goldCoins mapping
id parameter indexes the goldCoins mapping
goldBalance calls getGoblinsCoins for each owned token
goldBalance accumulates coin values into total
person parameter drives balanceOf and tokenOfOwnerByIndex calls
total local value is returned by goldBalance
pause onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender
pause sets paused to true
unpause onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender
unpause sets paused to false
